Design authority: docs/delivery/workspace-design.md, sections 1 and 11; sole four-screen completion witness. Visual references: mockups/workspace-vision-2026-09-22/README.md.
Repository owner: storyatlas4s. Delivery boundary: post-M1 / extended capability.
Integration parent: bd-01M1C2A5HGJ0MM1X7N8Z5EAZBD; parent relationship does not itself block execution.
Entry dependencies: bd-01M34JJ7A88WEAR1MX61B5Q3J9, bd-01M35A7CYNA8C2B3DV534449E3, bd-01M35A7DJX9CXQ84FKBFV401G5, bd-01M35A7EEC15KAFN2K1M5EFCAH, bd-01M35A7F38MAF40D5NRV4F0CTG, bd-01M35A7F9AFXF2BN6J2PDK3VJQ.

REUSE, SCOPE AND PRESERVATION
Own final exact-pair product acceptance integrating all four mockups. Reuse M1 final receipt and source/scale/film/accessibility/comprehension receipts; their scope and source compatibility must match. This is narrower than the overall epic, which retains feature/cohort/temporal/chronology/interview obligations.

ACCEPTANCE AND FAILURE WITNESSES
1. On the actual application, complete source-only reading, text recall, whole-film recall and retained-context film exploration, with complete inventory and evidence/uncertainty accounting.
2. All applicable A-K design courts, exact builds/browser checks, independent exported-subset recovery, readable responsive views and final human comprehension target pass; missing capability remains a blocker.
3. Record exact revisions, actual overrides, artifact digests, results/warnings/skips and separate review; only redundant entry wrappers with caller/format parity are eligible for later retirement.

EVIDENCE
Record exact producer/consumer/dependency revisions, fixture digests, actual commands/results and warnings/skips. Apply design section 11.5 and AGENTS.md to the changed runtime boundary, including compileAll testAll scalafmtCheckAll app/fastLinkJS and relevant existing/new browser courts for shell changes; use isolated siblings and session-owned project browsers. Documentation-only or human-study evidence is scoped as such. New test names are specifications until implemented and run. No inference, calibration, hosted CI, publication or release is certified by ticket creation.

FALLBACK
Qualify a narrower named capability set if blocked, without closing this ticket or automatically closing the broader epic.

Coordinate one implementation writer and one heavy build at a time. Reserve exact paths when taking the ticket; do not claim other writers' scopes. Keep scientific operations in StoryModel, reuse this application and preserve unrelated edits.

PRESERVATION ACCEPTANCE (owner clarification; design sections 2.1 and 11.6)
Reconcile the delivered capability set against the initial inventory in bd-01M35A79XQJRP3JTHJYVQ741YZ and M1 preservation evidence. Link per-slice comparisons and retained supported routes for sound existing code, including publication, features and standalone artifacts whose integrated UI may remain a separate obligation. For each replacement/removal, require the recorded limitation, why a narrow extension was insufficient, exact callers/formats, comparison evidence and reviewed migration. Merely retaining source files is insufficient if the supported workflow breaks. Unexplained loss blocks promotion; documented defect corrections remain explicit. The mockups do not independently authorize discarding an existing capability.
